options.label: Hold button
options.description:
The controller hotkey is two buttons: hold this one and press the one below. Together they open fast travel from anywhere while you play, the same as the keyboard hotkey, and close it again.

Unbound makes the hotkey a single press of the button below.

The default is the left stick pressed in (LS, L3 on PlayStation).

options.label: Press button
options.description:
The button to press while holding the one above. Unbound turns the controller hotkey off.

The default is the right stick pressed in (RS, R3 on PlayStation).

In a mission, the first press asks. Then hold the buttons for 5 seconds to abandon the mission and fast travel.

Works with Xbox controllers, most PC controllers, and DualSense and DualShock 4 controllers, with or without Steam Input.
